# Activate pay-as-you-go for HCP Terraform

This topic describes how to activate pay-as-you-go billing for your HCP Terraform organization.

<Note>

HCP Europe organizations do not support pay-as-you-go billing.

@include 'eu/billing.mdx'

</Note>

## Requirements

- Organization owner permissions
- HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP) account
- Valid payment method

## Activate pay-as-you-go

Complete the following steps to enable pay-as-you-go billing and change your organization's plan:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select your organization.
1. Choose **Settings** from the sidebar, then **Plan & Billing**.
1. Click **Edit plan** to authenticate with HCP and link your accounts.
1. In the **How would you like to activate HCP Terraform** section, enable **On a HashiCorp Trial or Pay-as-you-go account**.
1. Select the HCP organization to bill your usage to, then click **Next**.
1. Select the plan to use for your organization, then click **Next**.
1. Review your plan summary, then click **Activate**.

The new feature set is available immediately and usage tracking starts. Refer to [Estimate your costs](/terraform/cloud-docs/overview/estimate-cost) for information on reviewing your organization's consumption.

## Manage billing

You can manage billing on HashiCorp Cloud Platform. You can perform the following actions:

- Review your organization's [usage](/hcp/docs/hcp/admin/billing#usage)
- Change the [credit card](/hcp/docs/hcp/admin/billing/pay-as-you-go#change-credit-card) used for payment
- Set up a [Flex Billing Contract](/hcp/docs/hcp/admin/billing/flex-multiyear)
